Decomposing the CBAM effect

Pure reallocation vs. green technology

The EU expects two effects from CBAM: (1) the supplier basket changes and (2) exporters invest in cleaner production. Each country emission factor is fixed in every simulated scenario, so everything below is what reallocation alone delivers, with no technological response from exporters. All three sectors are compared side by side for the scenario selected above.

Do dirtier countries lose more share?

Volume-weighted average carbon intensity of the country vs. change in share. Each dot is one basket country in the selected scenario.

Standard basket = top non-EU exporters subject to CBAM (by volume) plus Brazil and Argentina, always included even when small. EU/EEA/Swiss countries bear no CBAM cost and absorb part of the share lost by taxed exporters, as does the "Others" block (the long tail of exporters outside the basket). Prices are post-tax; base shares use a 3-year window (2023-2025).
